visual_action: The video is a montage of scenes from rural America. It begins with a slow pan across a farm at sunrise, showing a dirt road and a field. This transitions to a series of clips featuring large John Deere agricultural machinery at work: a combine harvester in a cornfield, an aerial view of a harvester and tractor in a grain field, a tractor in a green field, and a large sprayer moving through a crop field. The final sequence shows black and white dairy cows eating from a trough in a sunlit barn. The video concludes with a black screen displaying the White House logo and text.
